title: Add 3D rotating background with continuously changing camera angles

requirements.text: Replace the current animated gradient background with a Three.js 3D scene that continuously rotates and changes camera angles to create a calming, unique visual effect

quotes: یک تصویر سه بعدی بذار که دایما درحال جابجایی زوایای آن هستیم که آرامش‌بخش و عجیب هست

acceptanceCriteria: 3D scene replaces the existing animated gradient background on LoginScreen
Camera continuously rotates around the 3D object with smooth, calming motion
Camera angles change dynamically to create visual interest
Animation is smooth and does not impact application performance
3D scene works in both light and dark themes

requirements.text: Implement the 3D scene using React Three Fiber with an abstract geometric shape that serves as the focal point for the rotating camera
acceptanceCriteria: React Three Fiber Canvas component is integrated into LoginScreen.tsx
3D geometry is abstract and visually interesting
Lighting setup enhances the calming effect
Scene renders efficiently without blocking UI interactions

requirements.text: Configure camera animation to rotate continuously with varying speeds and angles to create a unique, mesmerizing effect that never repeats exactly
acceptanceCriteria: Camera position changes smoothly over time
Rotation speeds vary subtly to avoid monotony
Camera always keeps the 3D object in view
Animation loop is seamless with no jarring transitions

requirements.text: Ensure the 3D background maintains visual harmony with the existing OKLCH color system and adapts to light/dark theme changes
acceptanceCriteria: 3D scene colors are derived from the existing OKLCH theme variables
Material colors adjust appropriately when theme is toggled
3D background does not clash with foreground UI elements
Scene maintains adequate contrast for text readability

constraints: Use React Three Fiber for 3D rendering implementation
Maintain compatibility with the existing Persian RTL layout
Do not change the authentication flow or Internet Identity integration
Preserve the existing LoginScreen component structure and branding elements
nonGoals: Adding user controls to manipulate the 3D scene
Creating interactive 3D elements that respond to mouse/touch input
Implementing multiple 3D scenes or scene switching
Adding sound effects or audio to the animation
